fullContentHtml:
SBI Clerk 1st Wait List 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : State Bank of India (SBI) has released the 1st wait list for the recruitment of SBI Clerk Examination 2025 on its official website. This recruitment was released for 5180 Posts. Applications for the SBI Clerk Pre Recruitment 2025 were accepted from August 06, 2025, to August 26, 2025. SBI Clerk was held recently on 22, 20, 21 and 27 September, 2025 in Online Mode on the various Centres of Country. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their SBI Clerk 1st Wait List 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 05 August 2025
  • Application Start Date : 06 August 2025
  • Last Date : 26 August 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 August 2025
  • PET Exam Date : September 2025
  • PET Admit Card : 02 September 2025
  • Pre Exam Date : 20, 21 & 27 September 2025
  • Pre Admit Card : 14 September 2025
  • Pre Result : 04 November 2025
  • Mains Exam Date : 21 November 2025
  • Mains Admit Card : 14 November 2025
  • Mains Result : 27 February 2026
  • Score Card : 10 March 2026
  • 1st Wait List : 19 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
